registration.projection: Caller supplies already projected SurfaceLevel deck center. Never add another four levels here. Base TMP separately uses Level.
registration.frameState: High overlay state 0..8 plus 0/9 axis offset; paired shadow is colorIndex+18. BRIDGE1 0/7/8 are exercised by retained original maps. Second axis and wooden high bridges are source-geometric coverage, absent from these five maps.
registration.anchor: Derived deck-plane registration from original native deck geometry, checked against unchanged original TMP roadheads in static scenes. Not a claim about original executable draw offsets or bbox recentering.
registration.low: Selected native low bridge deck center is (90,50), equivalent to previous tile-top (90,35)+15. Native empty lane states stay empty. Unselected damaged siblings use same deck plane and native lane index.
registration.shadow: Original index1 coverage is retained unchanged; renderer modulates this mask to black at nominal alpha0.32, never displays cyan as color.
registration.foreground: High masks retain original pixels outside the deck near edge only. Above-deck rail semantics are not guessed; low bridges reuse previously verified source near-timber masks.
registration.crates: One original color frame plus one index1 shadow, anchor(30,45). Tick intentionally does not animate this single-frame asset. No rewardKind information or guessed icon.
